categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: live streaming e-commerce, e-commerce direct sales, and mineral products business including lithium mining and other mineral product trading. It also has leasing and game operation businesses, but these are minor in revenue contribution. The company is transitioning its focus from live streaming e-commerce to e-commerce direct sales and expanding into the new energy sector, particularly lithium mining and battery materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages internet live streaming and short video marketing technologies for its e-commerce business, focusing on integrated live streaming services combining people, goods, and scenes. In the lithium mining segment, it employs mining and beneficiation technologies for lithium extraction from pegmatite deposits. The company also invests in new energy technologies related to lithium battery materials and green sulfuric acid production, with ongoing construction of beneficiation plants.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include end consumers purchasing leisure snacks and food products via e-commerce platforms such as Douyin, Kuaishou, and others. In the mineral segment, customers are industrial buyers in lithium battery manufacturing, new energy, and related sectors. The company mainly serves the domestic Chinese market, with minimal international sales. The new energy business targets the expanding lithium battery and energy storage markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major operations in Shenzhen and Guangxi Free Trade Zone. Lithium mining assets are located in Sanmenxia, Henan Province. It also has subsidiaries in Hainan and Hong Kong. The company’s e-commerce activities cover major Chinese online platforms. International exposure is minimal.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and downstream in the supply chain. Upstream, it controls lithium mining and beneficiation operations. Midstream, it engages in processing and trading of mineral products. Downstream, it operates e-commerce platforms for direct sales and live streaming marketing of consumer goods, mainly food products. It also provides integrated live streaming services as a marketing channel.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is shifting from live streaming e-commerce to e-commerce direct sales with a focus on building self-owned food brands and multi-channel sales. It is investing in lithium mining and new energy projects to establish a dual business model of e-commerce and new energy. R&D efforts focus on product innovation in food categories and advancing lithium beneficiation and battery material technologies. The company also emphasizes talent development and technology upgrades in information systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales in e-commerce direct sales and live streaming commission fees. The company earns service fees from live streaming marketing and brand promotion. Mineral product sales contribute through direct sales of lithium ore and other minerals. Leasing income from investment properties is another revenue source. The company also gains investment income from equity holdings and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the live streaming e-commerce sector from major platforms and numerous broadcasters, leading to declining revenues in this segment. In lithium mining and new energy, it competes with established mining companies and battery material suppliers. The company positions itself as a growing player transitioning to a dual focus on e-commerce and new energy, leveraging its mining assets and e-commerce capabilities to enhance competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 161 million, a 35.5% decline from 2023, mainly due to strategic restructuring and reduced live streaming business. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 316 million, worsening from the previous year. Total assets stood at around RMB 1.07 billion, down 34% year-over-year. The company is in a transformation phase with investments in new energy projects yet to generate significant revenue, reflecting a challenging growth profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated live streaming services combining hosts, products, and sales channels to enhance marketing efficiency. It differentiates by developing proprietary food brands tailored to online consumer preferences and leveraging multi-platform e-commerce channels. In new energy, it leverages exclusive lithium mining rights and beneficiation capabilities to secure upstream resources, aiming to provide stable supply and cost advantages. The dual business model aims to balance growth and risk, offering diversified value to customers and investors.
